entities.name: Dawning Archaic
entities.description: A massive Archaic avatar of Arcavios, formed from the soul of the last-ever Oracle, destabilized by disrupted time.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An Oracle kidnapped by the Dawning Archaic and pushed into a nexus.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: Where the Dawning Archaic appeared; a titan containing a nexus of wild energy.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: Quandrix mage-student who pushed Jadzi into the nexus.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: Witherbloom mage-student who finished the calming ritual.

entities.name: Lumarets
entities.description: Called upon to help encase the Archaic.

events.summary: The Dawning Archaic appears in Titan's Grave and kidnaps Oracle Jadzi.
events.quote: the Dawning Archaic appeared in Titan's Grave and kidnapped Oracle Jadzi

events.summary: After Chandra attacks it, the Archaic falls into a chamber with a nexus of wild energy.
events.quote: After being attacked by Chandra Nalaar , they fell into a chamber within the titan

events.summary: Jadzi's calming ritual is disrupted by Chandra, then Tamira pushes Jadzi into the nexus, making her disappear from reality.
events.quote: Jadzi was pushed into the nexus by the Quandrix mage-student Tamira , causing her to disappear from reality

events.summary: Lluwen finishes the ritual himself, calling on his friends and the Lumarets to encase the Archaic in their unity and stop its rampage.
events.quote: Witherbloom mage-student Lluwen was forced to finish the ritual himself

relations.quote: After being attacked by Chandra Nalaar

relations.note: Pushed her into the nexus so she disappeared from reality
relations.quote: Jadzi was pushed into the nexus by the Quandrix mage-student Tamira
